data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'athaba' meaning 'to seek' or 'to strive for'. Jathbiyya is a name given to a girl who is a diligent seeker of knowledge and wisdom in her life. The name Jathbiyya carries the meaning “Seeker of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jathbiyya usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
